# ugee

> ugee is a 23+ year digital drawing hardware manufacturer specializing in affordable drawing tablets, pen displays, and standalone drawing devices for beginners and digital artists.

ugee offers a comprehensive range of input devices including portable drawing tablets (M708, M808, M908, Q6), pen displays (UE16, UE12, UE12 Plus, U1200), and standalone tablets (UT3, UT2) designed for digital drawing, digital art, and creative productivity. The company combines accessibility with professional-grade features like pressure sensitivity and battery-free styluses.

## Key Topics

- Drawing tablets
- Pen displays
- Standalone tablets
- Pressure sensitivity
- Battery-free stylus
- Portable display
- Digital drawing
- Graphics tablets
- Beginner-friendly
- Digital art

- UT3
- IPS display
- NanoMatte finish
